title: Das Vorstellungsgespräch beim Schwiegervater
style: Cinematic 3D animated movie still, Pixar-meets-photoreal style, highly detailed skin and fabric textures, dramatic warm golden lighting, dark luxury color palette (black, burgundy, gold), shallow depth of field, anthropomorphic food-headed characters, vertical 9:16 composition, no text except the forehead displays

music.description: Brazilian funk / batida beat, about 130 BPM, punchy tamborzão drums, deep 808 bass, playful and confident, no vocals

WURST.name: Wurst (Ich-Figur)
WURST.prompt: a slim young man whose entire head is a glossy pink-orange sausage (wiener) with a little tied knot on top, cartoon face with big expressive brown eyes and thick dark eyebrows, a red glowing digital LED display embedded in his forehead showing "9.999", wearing a slightly oversized cheap grey suit, white shirt, crooked thin black tie, black sneakers

VATER.name: Schwiegervater (Ananas)
VATER.prompt: a tall imposing broad-shouldered man in his fifties whose entire head is a large golden pineapple with a spiky green crown on top, stern face with heavy brows, narrow unimpressed eyes and a tight mouth, a red glowing digital LED display embedded in his forehead showing "50.000.000", wearing a perfectly tailored white three-piece suit, gold watch, gold rings, holding a thick cigar
VATER.voice_note: tief, ruhig, trocken, monoton, wenige Worte

LARA.name: Lara (Tochter)
LARA.prompt: a beautiful young woman in Pixar style with long wavy dark brown hair, warm brown eyes, soft smile, a red glowing digital LED display on her forehead showing "250.000", wearing an elegant black satin dress and delicate gold jewelry

BUTLER.name: Butler (Champagnerflasche)
BUTLER.prompt: a very upright butler whose entire head is a dark green champagne bottle with gold foil around the neck and a cork on top, cartoon face with a monocle and a thin curled moustache, a red glowing digital LED display on the bottle showing "1.200.000", wearing a black tailcoat, white bow tie and white gloves

PFERD.name: Pfirsich-Pferd (spricht nicht)
PFERD.prompt: a majestic stallion with a fuzzy peach-colored orange-pink coat like peach skin, a small green leaf on its forehead next to a red glowing LED display showing "800.000", golden bridle and golden saddle

locations.HALL: grand mansion entrance hall at night, sweeping white marble double staircase with black wrought-iron and gold railings, giant crystal chandeliers, polished reflective marble floor
locations.STABLE: luxury horse stable with dark wood and brass fittings at golden hour, warm sunset light through tall open doors, straw on the floor, a paddock with palm trees outside
locations.YACHT: deck of a huge black superyacht on a turquoise sea at sunset, teak deck, a golf tee mat set up at the railing, gold golf club, champagne glasses on a side table
locations.DINING: opulent dark dining hall, long black marble table with candles and gold candelabras, burgundy velvet chairs, oil paintings in gold frames, warm candlelight

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Du willst also meine Tochter heiraten?
shots.action: the giant pineapple father looms over the small nervous sausage guy, Lara stands smiling next to the sausage guy
shots.motion: slow push-in, father speaks slowly and leans forward, sausage guy swallows nervously

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy smiling awkwardly, sweating, hand rubbing the back of his neck
shots.motion: he nods too fast and speaks with an awkward grin

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father staring down unimpressed, cigar smoke rising
shots.motion: he takes a puff of the cigar and speaks calmly, eyes narrow

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy looks away and gestures vaguely with both hands, Lara giggles behind him
shots.motion: he waves his hands searching for words, glances at Lara for help

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.camera: extreme close-up on the face and LED display
shots.action: pineapple father, the forehead display 50.000.000 glowing
shots.motion: very slow push-in, he speaks without moving any other muscle

shots.speaker: LARA
shots.action: Lara touches her father's arm and smiles
shots.motion: she tilts her head and speaks playfully, father does not react

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father turns and walks towards the door, sausage guy left standing confused
shots.motion: father turns away and walks, sausage guy looks around in panic

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy with raised eyebrows, arms open
shots.motion: he quickly follows, speaking with a squeaky voice

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: father points with his cigar at the peach stallion, sausage guy stands next to it holding the reins awkwardly
shots.motion: slow dolly in, the horse snorts and shakes its mane

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.text: Okay… und was mach ich mit dem Riesenpfirsich?
shots.action: sausage guy looks the peach stallion up and down, scratching his head
shots.motion: he scratches his head, the horse stares at him and blinks

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father, completely unimpressed
shots.motion: he blinks once and speaks flatly

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.text: Das Pferd hat achthunderttausend auf der Stirn!
shots.camera: close-up on the horse forehead display, sausage guy in the foreground
shots.action: sausage guy pointing at the horse's glowing 800.000 display, eyes wide
shots.motion: rack focus from the sausage guy to the horse display, horse lifts its head proudly

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father exhaling cigar smoke
shots.motion: he exhales smoke and says one word

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.text: Euer Pferd verdient mehr als ich?
shots.action: sausage guy looking from his own forehead display 9.999 to the horse's 800.000
shots.motion: he looks back and forth between the two numbers in disbelief

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Unser Pferd verdient mehr als die meisten.
shots.action: father strokes the horse's neck proudly
shots.motion: he pats the horse, the horse neighs

shots.speaker: BUTLER
shots.action: the champagne butler appears behind the sausage guy who is lying in the straw after falling off the horse, the butler's cork pops off with a little burst of foam
shots.motion: the cork pops off the butler's head, he speaks without emotion

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy sitting in the straw with hay on his head, looking up startled
shots.motion: he jerks back and shouts

shots.speaker: BUTLER
shots.action: champagne butler adjusting his white gloves
shots.motion: he adjusts his gloves and his monocle glints

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy pointing at the butler's bottle head
shots.motion: he points dramatically, the butler stays motionless

shots.speaker: BUTLER
shots.action: champagne butler with the LED display 1.200.000 glowing, slight smug look
shots.motion: slow push-in, he raises one eyebrow

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: father hands the sausage guy a gold golf club at the tee mat by the railing
shots.motion: camera slowly orbits, father hands over the club

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.tts: Oh… der ist jetzt im Meer.
shots.action: sausage guy after a terrible swing, watching a shiny golden ball fly into the sea
shots.motion: he swings badly, the golden ball flies over the railing and splashes into the water

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father staring at the sea
shots.motion: he slowly turns his head toward the sausage guy

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy with both hands on his head in disbelief
shots.motion: he grabs his head and shouts

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father sipping champagne
shots.motion: he takes a sip, shrugs slightly

shots.speaker: BUTLER
shots.action: champagne butler standing stiffly with a silver tray, his cork pops off again
shots.motion: the cork pops, foam fizzes, he speaks without emotion

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy sitting at the long table staring at a row of fourteen gold forks next to his plate
shots.motion: slow pan along the row of forks to the confused sausage guy

shots.speaker: LARA
shots.action: Lara leaning over and whispering to the sausage guy, smiling
shots.motion: she leans in and whispers

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy sweating, hand hovering over the forks
shots.motion: his hand hovers back and forth over the forks

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.camera: medium shot at the head of the table
shots.action: pineapple father at the head of the table holding a fork
shots.motion: he picks up a fork without looking

shots.speaker: BUTLER
shots.text: Die Rechnung, Sir. In diesem Haus zahlt der Gast.
shots.action: champagne butler placing a black leather bill folder in front of the sausage guy
shots.motion: he places the folder down with a gloved hand and steps back

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy opening the bill folder, the bill shows 9.990 €, his eyes huge
shots.motion: he opens the folder and his eyes go wide, camera snap zoom

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.action: sausage guy tapping a card on a payment terminal, his forehead display counting down from 9.999 to 9
shots.motion: he taps the card, the forehead number rapidly counts down to 9

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father raising one eyebrow for the first time
shots.motion: one eyebrow slowly rises

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.text: Ja… war alles, was ich hatte.
shots.action: sausage guy with forehead display showing 9, smiling weakly
shots.motion: he shrugs with a sad little smile

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father leaning forward
shots.motion: he leans forward slowly

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.text: Weil ich sie liebe. Und weil der Butler mich so angeschaut hat.
shots.action: sausage guy holding Lara's hand, the butler in the background staring at him
shots.motion: he looks at Lara, then nervously glances at the butler

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Du bist der Erste, der nicht weggerannt ist.
shots.action: pineapple father puts down his cigar, a tiny smile appears
shots.motion: he puts the cigar down, a slight smile forms

shots.speaker: LARA
shots.text: Ich hab dir doch gesagt, er ist anders.
shots.action: Lara beaming with happiness
shots.motion: she smiles and squeezes the sausage guy's hand

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: pineapple father puts his big hand on the sausage guy's shoulder
shots.motion: he puts his hand on his shoulder, the sausage guy's forehead display flickers

shots.speaker: WURST
shots.camera: extreme close-up on the forehead display
shots.action: sausage guy's forehead display jumping from 9 to 9.000.000, glowing brightly
shots.motion: the display numbers spin rapidly up to 9.000.000, his eyes go huge

shots.speaker: BUTLER
shots.action: champagne butler, cork popping and champagne fountaining out like a celebration
shots.motion: the cork pops and champagne sprays upward, he stays perfectly still

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.action: sausage guy fainted backwards on the floor next to his chair, Lara kneeling beside him, father looking down with his cigar
shots.motion: the sausage guy falls backwards, father takes a puff of his cigar
